name: The Fool
meaning_upright: New beginnings, innocence, trust in the universe, a leap of faith.
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, naivety, hesitation, fear of the unknown.

name: The Star
meaning_upright: Hope, renewal, spiritual connection, inner calm, guidance.
meaning_reversed: Doubt, lack of faith, discouragement, feeling disconnected.

name: Ace of Cups
meaning_upright: Emotional opening, new love, intuition, creative flow.
meaning_reversed: Emotional block, holding back feelings, creative drought.
